channel.title: Voice Note Transcribe — Updates
channel.description: Dated, truthful updates on the WhatsApp voice note transcription tool — what shipped, what was decided, all built in the open.

item.title: Talk to your results — and tell the tool what to do next
item.description: The chat pane ships: converse with your transcript and summary, and drive the tool itself from the chat — redraw the infographic, edit the materials, check your costs. Now live, validated with a real key.

item.title: Every release now has a page — and you can see which one you're running
item.description: The Versions page lists every CI tag with its date, headline and full diff; the version chip now sits on every page footer.

item.title: When your key is the problem, the app now says so
item.description: A disabled OpenRouter key used to read as a network error. The app now re-checks the key and names the real cause.

item.title: Your infographic is now a finished picture — and you get one by default
item.description: The infographic stage now uses an image model by default — a publication-quality picture, with a model picker and a redraw button.

item.title: Look under the bonnet: a debug pane, sample voice notes, and three fixes
item.description: Every LLM request and response visible verbatim, editable prompts, clickable sample notes — and CI now tests every release.

item.title: A bug worth telling you about: some .ogg files were transcribed wrongly
item.description: Some .ogg voice notes came back as fluent transcripts of audio nobody recorded. Found, fixed with content sniffing, regression-tested, and reported upstream — written up in full.

item.title: The product is live: drop a voice note, get everything back
item.description: The one-pass ships: transcript, summary and infographic from a single drop, with your own OpenRouter key, in your browser.

item.title: The site has its own front door
item.description: The public Library page — every doc behind the product, organised by audience.

item.title: The build has its briefs
item.description: Conductor, Architect, Dev and Designer briefs for importing the proven transcription engine and building the branded one-pass on top.

item.title: From empty repo to working project in one day
item.description: Brief pack, agentic team, issue queue, library and a published site — the bootstrap, in public from commit one.
